{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Identify QA rows: revenue == 999999.99
qa_rows = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']

# Count them
num_qa_rows = len(qa_rows)

# Filter out QA rows and then count completed orders
valid_orders = df[df['revenue'] != '999999.99']
completed_orders = valid_orders[valid_orders['status'] == 'completed']
count_completed = len(completed_orders)

print(f"Number of QA rows: {num_qa_rows}")
print(f"Number of completed orders (excluding QA): {count_completed}")"}
